items.title: Target (TGT) Launches National Beauty Studio In More Than 600 Stores
items.summary: Target (NYSE:TGT) rolled out its national Beauty Studio concept, adding hundreds of new prestige and global beauty brands across stores. The retailer introduced multiple U.S. exclusive beauty partnerships through Beauty Studio, aimed at younger and more premium shoppers. Target expanded its assortment in food with Coast to Coast Kitchen, Wild Alaskan Company and Amylu Foods, and added home-care brand The Laundress.
